description: Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number or group. Auto-resolves which channel to use (org default > first connected). Supports text, image, audio, video, and document types.

channelId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of a specific channel to override auto-resolution

contactName.description: Display name for the recipient contact

mediaUrl.description: URL of media to attach (required for non-text message types)

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time for scheduled delivery (e.g., '2025-12-31T10:00:00Z'). Message sends immediately if omitted.

template.description: Approved template (official WhatsApp Business API sessions only). Required to reach anyone who hasn't messaged you in the last 24 hours. Set messageType to 'template'.

components.description: Meta send-time components with variable values, e.g. [{ type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Ada' }] }]. Omit for templates without variables.

name.description: Template name exactly as approved (see neuron_list_whatsapp_templates)

text.description: Message text content (optional when sending a template)

to.description: Recipient: phone number (e.g., '2348012345678') or group JID (e.g., '120363XXX@g.us')

name: neuron_send_whatsapp
title: Send WhatsApp Message
